text: The Π-type Π(x:A).B(x) is a generalisation of the function type A→B where ______.
choices: the codomain B may depend on the argument x
the domain A may depend on x
both A and B are propositions
A must be a finite type
answer: the codomain B may depend on the argument x
explanation: Π(x:A).B(x) generalises A→B by allowing the return type B to mention the input x.
